name: The haidut (a .vox unit)
description: An example of a unit drawn in MagicaVoxel: an 18th-century Bulgarian man in haidut dress, as a new creature (the human, drawn his own way). His looks are one .vox file, data/voxel/models/haidut.vox, written by tools/haidut.lobster; open it in MagicaVoxel to see how a body is drawn: standing, a piece an object, a hidden points layer. Original art.
